behaviors.description: Internal word splitter: String() coercion, NFKD normalization, strips combining diacritics U+0300-U+036F, splits camelCase boundaries ([a-z0-9][A-Z]), splits on any run of non-alphanumerics, drops empty parts, lowercases each word.

slugify(input, options): throws TypeError('slugify expects a string') for non-string input; joins words with options.separator (default '-', falsy separator falls back to '-'); when options.maxLength is an integer and the slug is longer, slices to maxLength then strips any trailing separator(s).

truncate(text, max, ellipsis): ellipsis defaults to '...' only when undefined; throws RangeError('max must be a non-negative integer') for non-integer or negative max; returns text unchanged when length <= max; returns tail.slice(0, max) when max <= tail length; otherwise text.slice(0, max - tail.length) + tail.
titleCase(input): words(input) with each word's first character uppercased, joined by a single space.
Generated case converters from SEPARATORS {kebab:'-', snake:'_'}: kebabCase(input) = words(input).join('-'), snakeCase(input) = words(input).join('_'). No type check (input is String()-coerced).

Public export surface: module.exports = createApi() yields {slugify, truncate, titleCase, kebabCase, snakeCase}, plus module.exports.VERSION = '2.1.0'. The target is the ESM module src/utils/strings.js exposing the same named exports consumed by src/index.js.
